description: Gate A golden of the M0 test room: the scene camera's view, the last frame of a 30-frame run, regenerated after the review of M0 step 12. The style 26.2 checklist for it is in docs/testing/gate-a.md.

image.format: PNG, 8-bit RGB, sRGB-encoded as the window shows it

scene.camera: scene camera: eye (-0.6, 1.65, 0.9) m, yaw 9 deg, pitch -7 deg, horizontal FOV 75 deg

build.sources: gitCommit plus the changes of the commit that adds this metadata ("step12: address review findings"), rendered from that working tree before committing: check out that commit to reproduce the bytes

rebaselined: 2026-10-30: driver 621.01 (was 617.42) rendered the same bytes (equal SHA-256) from commit 6338e017 with tests/smoke/test_golden.cpp's run; the gpu fields were updated by hand (test_golden.cpp has no RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN), the image and the build it names are unchanged
comparison: The same build, driver and scene give the same bytes (two runs matched, and msvc-x64-release writes the same bytes as msvc-x64-debug). Another driver or GPU can move pixels by an 8-bit step or two (dither, texture filtering, FXAA): compare with a tolerance.
